title: deskcrit compare
description: The JSON document that crit compare --json writes (docs/PRD.md section 8.2, FR-35 to FR-37, FR-39). It holds the before and the after report, each without its own usage, one change per criterion that both runs asked, the criteria that only one run asked, a summary, and the usage summed over both runs. Report fields are a $ref to schemas/report.schema.json, so the shapes cannot drift apart; a validator must load report.schema.json under the id report.schema.json. Written for JSON Schema draft 2020-12; the $schema keyword is left out by project rule. Unknown fields are rejected, as in the report schema.

before.description: The report on the before image, without its own usage (section 8.2).

after.description: The report on the after image, without its own usage (section 8.2).

changes.description: One entry for each criterion that both runs asked, sorted by criterion (FR-36, section 8.2).

skipped.description: Each criterion that only one run asked, with the run that skipped it and why, sorted by criterion (FR-36, section 8.2).

summary.description: The count of each kind of change (FR-39).

usage.description: The usage summed over both runs (FR-33).

change.description: How one criterion that both runs asked changed (FR-36, FR-37).
uncertain when either finding is uncertain (FR-37); otherwise decided by the verdicts and then the values (FR-36).

model.description: The versioned model id, the same as the top-level model (FR-33).

change_side.description: One run's verdict for the criterion and the value the verdict rule read: the probability of true for noul, the most probable level index for score, and the most probable option name for choice (FR-36).

skipped_entry.description: A criterion that only one run asked (FR-36, section 8.2).

run.description: The run that skipped the criterion.

reason.description: The reason the skipping run gave, as in its own skipped list.
